# Website artwork

Generated with the built-in OpenAI image-generation tool on 23 October 2026,
using the imagegen skill. These are concept illustrations, not app screenshots.
WebP exports preserve the entire composition and the foreground window's alpha.
Original PNGs are retained locally in `output/website-artwork` (not shipped).

## Prompt set

Shared direction: precision-machined silver/graphite devices, pale mineral-gray
studio, sculptural evergreen #184C37 and leaf #B9E66B ribbon landscapes, realistic
materials and contact shadows. No words, logos, watermark, blue palette or toy
geometry. All objects fully framed.

- `connected-workspace.webp`: desktop rear-left, laptop front-right, Android
  phone front-center, a continuous architectural green landscape on their screens
  and one luminous floating glass application pane.
- `mirror.webp`: floating phone and silver laptop displaying the same green
  ribbon artwork, with a translucent pane bridging them.
- `control.webp`: graphite phone beside a physical evergreen cursor reaching a
  lime focus target, with a floating glass application pane.
- `extend.webp`: two silver displays angled inward, one continuous green
  landscape with a lake and pale lime sun, a window spanning the boundary.
- `window.webp`: isolated translucent milky-white application pane containing
  folded evergreen/lime ribbons; very slight perspective, all corners in frame,
  genuinely transparent surroundings, no words or logos.

The website animates the separate window asset between screens. The studio
backgrounds remain still; playback can be paused and respects reduced motion.
